# nonGridRangeContainedIn

<link-summary>Checks whether one grid range is **not** entirely within another.</link-summary>

<web-summary>nonGridRangeContainedIn() — Checks whether one grid range is **not** entirely within another. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function nonGridRangeContainedIn(gridRange: GridRange, containerGridRange: GridRange): boolean;
```

The negation of `isGridRangeContainedIn`, written so that a guard clause reads as a sentence: a range that overlaps only partly, or lies elsewhere entirely, both answer `true`.

## Parameters

| Parameter            | Type        | Description                            |
| :------------------- | :---------- | :------------------------------------- |
| `gridRange`          | `GridRange` | The grid range to test.                |
| `containerGridRange` | `GridRange` | The grid range expected to contain it. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the first range is not inside the second.

## Examples

### Checking containment

```javascript
const inner = { startRowIndex: 1, endRowIndex: 2, startColumnIndex: 1, endColumnIndex: 2 };
const outer = { startRowIndex: 0, endRowIndex: 5, startColumnIndex: 0, endColumnIndex: 5 };

nonGridRangeContainedIn(outer, inner); // => true
```
